query:
UPDATE draft AS d
           SET path = $3
           WHERE d.workspace_id = $1
             AND d.path = $2
             AND d.typ::text = ANY($4::text[])
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM draft o
                 WHERE o.workspace_id = d.workspace_id
                   AND o.path = $3
                   AND o.typ = d.typ
                   AND o.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.email
             )
           RETURNING d.id
